about:
# shredder

shredder (short for Shredder Operating Manual) is a simple addon for World of Warcraft: Classic and World of Warcraft: Forever that tracks progress on the Horde quest chain The Lost Pages (Shredder Operating Manual).

Usage:

**Compact Mode** _(Default)_

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/cb160472-7e25-4d28-b00f-72871039fa2d)

- `/shredder` - displays progress for each chapter (I-III) of the overall quest and which pages are still needed on the current character
- `/shredderc name` - displays progress for character named "name" on the same realm as the currently logged in character
- `/shredderc name realm` - displays progress for character named "name" on the realm named "realm". Supports realms with spaces in name, e.g. `/shredder Thrall Lava Lash` will search for a character named "Thrall" on the realm "Lava Lash"

or

- `/shredderc` - displays progress for each chapter (I-III) of the overall quest and which pages are still needed on the current character
- `/shredderc name` - displays progress for character named "name" on the same realm as the currently logged in character
- `/shredderc name realm` - displays progress for character named "name" on the realm named "realm". Supports realms with spaces in name, e.g. `/shredder Thrall Lava Lash` will search for a character named "Thrall" on the realm "Lava Lash"

or

- `/sc` - displays progress for each chapter (I-III) of the overall quest and which pages are still needed on the current character
- `/sc name` - displays progress for character named "name" on the same realm as the currently logged in character
- `/sc name realm` - displays progress for character named "name" on the realm named "realm". Supports realms with spaces in name, e.g. `/shredder Thrall Lava Lash` will search for a character named "Thrall" on the realm "Lava Lash"

**Verbose Mode**

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/4e0e637a-cfbf-45d6-b135-ff5caa790f3b)

- `/shredderv` - displays progress for each chapter (I-III) of the overall quest and which pages are still needed on the current character
- `/shredderv name` - displays progress for character named "name" on the same realm as the currently logged in character
- `/shredderv name realm` - displays progress for character named "name" on the realm named "realm". Supports realms with spaces in name, e.g. `/shredder Thrall Lava Lash` will search for a character named "Thrall" on the realm "Lava Lash"

or

- `/sv` - displays progress for each chapter (I-III) of the overall quest and which pages are still needed on the current character
- `/sv name` - displays progress for character named "name" on the same realm as the currently logged in character
- `/sv name realm` - displays progress for character named "name" on the realm named "realm". Supports realms with spaces in name, e.g. `/shredder Thrall Lava Lash` will search for a character named "Thrall" on the realm "Lava Lash"

releases.notes: Updated how addon stores Forever data in response to the Forever API changes that no longer return realm names.

releases.name: shredder v1.5
releases.notes: Compatibility update for Forever. Addon now supports both Classic Era and Forever

releases.name: shredder v1.4
releases.notes: Compact mode is now the default, use `/shredder` or `/shredderc` or `/sc`. For the original standard mode, now known as verbose mode, use `/shredderv` or `/sv`.
